preToolUse.powershell: try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; try { $py=(Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if ($env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $s=if ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\hook_client.py' } else { '' } } else { $s="$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\hook_client.py" }; if ($py -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $py $s preToolUse } } catch {}; exit 0
preToolUse.bash: cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then s="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; else s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/hook_client.py"; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then python3 "$s" preToolUse || true; fi; exit 0

postToolUse.powershell: try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; try { $py=(Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if ($env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $s=if ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\hook_client.py' } else { '' } } else { $s="$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\hook_client.py" }; if ($py -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $py $s postToolUse } } catch {}; exit 0
postToolUse.bash: cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then s="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; else s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/hook_client.py"; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then python3 "$s" postToolUse || true; fi; exit 0

sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r -and -not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $r = (Get-Location).Path }; try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; $s = if ($r) { Join-Path $r 'scripts\hook_client.py' } else { '' }; if ((-not $s -or -not (Test-Path $s)) -and -not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $s = "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\hook_client.py" }; $py = Get-Command python -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Source; $ran = $false; if ($py -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $py $s sessionStart; $ran = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) }; if (-not $ran) { $b = if ($r) { Join-Path $r 'scripts\bootstrap-check.ps1' } else { '' }; if ((-not $b -or -not (Test-Path $b)) -and -not $env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $b = "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\bootstrap-check.ps1" }; if ($b -and (Test-Path $b)) { & $b } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') } }
sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "$r" ] && [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then r="$PWD"; fi; cd "${COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR:-$HOME}" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "$r" ]; then s="$r/scripts/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; if [ ! -f "$s" ] && [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/hook_client.py"; fi; ran=false; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then if python3 "$s" sessionStart; then ran=true; fi; fi; if [ "$ran" != true ]; then if [ -n "$r" ]; then b="$r/scripts/bootstrap-check.sh"; else b=""; fi; if [ ! -f "$b" ] && [ -z "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then b="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/bootstrap-check.sh"; fi; if [ -f "$b" ]; then bash "$b"; else printf '{}'; fi; fi

sessionEnd.powershell: try { Set-Location -LiteralPath $env:USERPROFILE -ErrorAction Stop } catch { try { Set-Location -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot((Get-Location).Path)) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory((Get-Location).Path) } catch {}; if ($env:COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT) { $py = Get-Command python -CommandType Application -All -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notlike '*\WindowsApps\*' } | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Source; $s=if ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { Join-Path $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT 'scripts\hook_client.py' } else { '' }; if ($py -and $s -and (Test-Path $s)) { & $py $s sessionEnd } } else { $s = "$env:USERPROFILE\.agent-worktrees\bin\deregister-session.ps1"; if (Test-Path $s) { & $s } }
sessionEnd.bash: cd "$HOME" 2>/dev/null || cd / 2>/dev/null || :; if [ -n "${COPILOT_EXTENSIONS_CONTEXT:-}" ]; then if [ -n "${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then s="$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/hook_client.py"; else s=""; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$s" ]; then python3 "$s" sessionEnd || true; fi; else s="$HOME/.agent-worktrees/bin/deregister-session.sh"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then bash "$s"; else :; fi; fi
